observations: Initial acquisition: three lowercase a pairs; Shift+A with Shift released first retains uppercase identity on A release; 1, Enter and Backspace pairs; held a produces one DOWN/UP; unplug while holding Shift+A synthesizes both UP events. Operator clarified no reconnection occurred in this run.
open_issue: USB HOST EP command error: ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE on removal; functional cleanup/reconnection observed, cause and qualification disposition pending.

corrections.description: The Author clarified that Agon was powered during these USB captures, but the Agon harness was not connected to the P4 right-side header (the same side as the USB connections). This supersedes the earlier assumption of a fully seated Agon/P4 harness for these runs. Native USB observations remain valid for this reported wiring state; simultaneous operation with the full Agon harness attached was not tested. The relation, if any, to the unplug diagnostic remains unestablished. No reconnection or hardware operation is implied by this correction.

review_addenda.finding: Pinned HID disconnect cleanup clears an endpoint whose IDF port is disabled; the logged invalid-state return is expected on this path. Functional acquisition observations pass. Original partial outcome retained; no artifact status change.
